text.body:
ahiṃsatāsteyam amaithunaṃ tathā śubhakriyeyaṃ trividhā śarīrataḥ |
abaddhasūcānṛtarūkṣavarjanaṃ caturvidho 'yaṃ niyamas tu vāṅmayaḥ || 17.1.5
% q in Dharmakīrti's Jātakamālāṭīkā attr. to Parahitaghoṣa
amadyapānāṣṭama eṣa saṃvaro yadā śubhājīvasamanvito bhavet |
tadā bhavec chīlavidhau vyavasthito vadanti dauḥśīlyam ato 'nyathā budhāḥ || 17.1.6
% q in Dharmakīrti's Jātakamālāṭīkā attr. to Parahitaghoṣa
kṣatena śīlena paraiti durgatiṃ manuṣyaloke mṛdunopapadyate |
prayāti madhyena tu ṣaḍvidhāṃ gatiṃ divaukasāṃ kāmavimuktacetasām || 17.1.7
tathaiva śīle 'bhyadhike pratiṣṭhitaś caturvidhe dhyānavidhau vyavasthitaḥ |
ato 'dhimātreṇa tu tena vartate śubhe samāpattividhau caturvidhe || 17.1.8
yadā tv anāmṛṣṭam akhaṇḍam akṣataṃ bibharti śīlaṃ śuci sajjanastutam |
tadā śivaṃ śāntam ahāryam avyayaṃ krameṇa nirvāṇam upaiti nirjvaram || 17.1.9
yathā pratiṣṭhā pṛthivī śarīriṇāṃ vanaspatīnām api vīrudhām api |
tathā śubhānām api sarvakarmaṇāṃ paraṃ pratiṣṭhā bhuvi śīlam ucyate || 17.1.10
% cf. Buddhacarita 23.17
yathā hi paṅgor gamanakriyā bhaved vipannapakṣasya ca khe parākramaḥ |
ṛte plavāc caiva yathā titīrṣutā tathā bhavec chīlam ṛte śubhā gatiḥ || 17.1.11
% cf. Buddhacarita 23.18
karotu vā mūlaphalena vartanaṃ tṛṇāṅkurais tuṣyatu vā samaṃ mṛgaiḥ |
payo'śano vāstu jalānna eva vā vipannaśīlo yadi naiva śudhyati || 17.1.12
% cf. Buddhacarita 23.24 (not 19?)
bhavantu mauṇḍyena śikhābhir eva vā vahantu vā snānajalākulā jaṭāḥ |
carantu vā naikavikalpavāsaso viḍambanaiṣā yadi śīlavarjitaḥ || 17.1.13
% cf. Buddhacarita 23.21
% Vasubandhu Śīlaparikathā 5
jalapraveśaṃ śiśire karotu vā pradīptam ārohatu vā hutāśanam |
gires taṭān mucyatu vā kalevaraṃ saced aśīlo vadha eva kevalaḥ || 17.1.14
% cf. Buddhacarita 23.23
paretu gaṅgām upayātu vā hradān sarasvatīṃ gacchatu puṣkarāṇi vā |
% anne: paraitu
niṣevatāṃ naimiṣam etu vā gayāṃ vipannaśīlo yadi niṣphalaḥ śramaḥ || 17.1.15
% Vasubandhu Śīlaparikathā 6
karotu vā triḥ salilāvagāhanaṃ trisandhyam agniṃ vidhivaj juhotu vā |
japavratejyādiṣu khedam etu vā na kiṃcid etad yadi śīlataḥ kṣataḥ || 17.1.16
% cf. Buddhacarita 23.22
vimānapṛṣṭheṣu jarāṃ prayātu vā sitāmbaro vā viharatv alaṃkṛtaḥ |
yatheṣṭam āhāraviśeṣam attu vā sthitaś ca śīle tridiveṣv avasthitaḥ || 17.1.17
% cf. Buddhacarita 23.20
yadi dvijātir yadi hīnayonijo vṛṇoti śīlaṃ vrajati tripiṣṭapam |
yadi dvijātir yadi hīnayonijo jahāti śīlaṃ na sa siddhim arcchati || 17.1.18
prayāti śūdro 'pi hi śīlavān divaṃ dvijo 'pi śīlaskhalito na gacchati |
sthireṇa śīlena nikṛṣṭayonijo munir mataṅgas tridive hi dīpyate || 17.1.19
yathāmbupūrṇaḥ sabhujaṅgamo hradaḥ praphullaśākhaś ca sakaṇṭako drumaḥ |
śrutena rūpeṇa kulena cānvitaḥ tathāvidhaḥ śīlaparāṅmukho naraḥ || 17.1.20
% cf. Buddhacarita 23.19
kulodgatānām iha mūrkhatā vadhaḥ śrutādhikānām api vismayo vadhaḥ |
nṛṇāṃ tu kārtsnyena vipannaśīlatā paratra caiveha ca dāruṇo vadhaḥ || 17.1.21
varaṃ daridro 'pi hi śīlavān bhaven na cārthavān apy analaṃkṛto guṇaiḥ |
daridrabhāve 'pi hi sajjanastuto raso guṇānām amṛtād viśiṣyate || 17.1.22
% anne: sajjanaḥ stuto
na mālyagandho hi tathā vikīryate pravāti gandho na tathānulepanāt |
anuttamaḥ śīlamayo yathā satāṃ pravāti gandho divi ceha cāvyayaḥ || 17.1.23
% Vasubandhu Śīlaparikathā 7
ihātmatuṣṭiḥ parataḥ śubhā gatir yaśaḥ priyatvaṃ bahumāna eva ca |
sukhaṃ ca tat tad bahu dṛṣṭadhārmikaṃ phalaṃ hi śīlasya maharṣayo viduḥ || 17.1.24
% cf. Buddhacarita 23.16
% Vasubandhu Śīlaparikathā 8
x x x x śraiṣṭhyam ajanma vā śivaṃ yathecchataḥ śīlavato na dūrataḥ |
viśuddhaśīlasya hi tadgatātmano narasya cetaḥpraṇidhiḥ samṛdhyati || 17.1.25
tathaiva duḥśīlam avekṣya duḥkhitaṃ vadhāvarodhavyasanādibhiḥ kṣatam |
ayaṃ na tāvan mayi doṣam aiṣyatīty ato 'pi toṣaṃ samupaiti śīlavān || 17.1.26
aho namasyā iti śīlavatsu ca praśasyamāneṣu guṇapriyair naraiḥ |
praharṣam āgacchati śīlavān naro mamāpi te santi śubhā guṇā iti || 17.1.27
vināśakāle samupasthite tathā rujāsu tīvrāsu rudatsu bandhuṣu |
śucīni śīlāni mameti nirvṛto bhayaṃ na mṛtyoḥ samupaiti śīlavān || 17.1.28
rujāsu śīlaṃ paramaṃ hi bheṣajaṃ bhayeṣu rakṣā vyasaneṣu bāndhavaḥ |
tamaḥsu dīpo viṣameṣu saṃkramo mahaty agādhe maraṇāmbhasi plavaḥ || 17.1.29
% Vasubandhu Śīlaparikathā 9
itīha śīlaṃ parikīrtitaṃ mayā yathābalaṃ śāstram avekṣya tattvataḥ |
pracodanārthaṃ ca kuśīlināṃ nṛṇāṃ suśīlināṃ sthairyanimittam eva ca || 17.1.30
